about: Sample library for the agents: each sound's description (hand-written, sources.json) and measurements (scripts/analyze.mjs). measured.brightness is the spectral centroid: dark < 600 Hz, warm < 1500, balanced < 3500, bright above. decaySeconds runs from the peak until 40 dB below it. Notes are sounding pitch in openDAW's naming, C3 = MIDI 60 = 261.6 Hz (measured.pitch checks them). Every sound is CC0.

samples.name: 808 Kick
samples.description: Deep sine kick with a slow pitch drop and a long sub tail, in the style of a Roland TR-808.

samples.name: Punch Kick
samples.description: Short, saturated kick with a click on the attack; cuts through a dense mix.

samples.name: Circuit Snare
samples.description: Two-tone body with a burst of filtered noise; crisp and short.

samples.name: Circuit Clap
samples.description: Three quick noise bursts and a short tail, like a drum machine hand clap.

samples.name: Circuit Rim
samples.description: Tiny high click for rimshot and side-stick patterns.

samples.name: Closed Hat
samples.description: Short metallic tick from six detuned square waves; the driving hat for 8th and 16th patterns.

samples.name: Open Hat
samples.description: The closed hat's sound left ringing; classic on the offbeats in house.

samples.name: Low Tom
samples.description: Low pitched sine tom with a quick downward bend.

samples.name: Mid Tom
samples.description: Middle sine tom; fills between the low and high toms.

samples.name: High Tom
samples.description: High sine tom, the top of the fill.

samples.name: Circuit Cowbell
samples.description: Two square waves through a bandpass: the drum machine cowbell.

samples.name: Circuit Crash
samples.description: Noisy metallic wash for the downbeat after a fill.

samples.name: Concert Bass Drum
samples.description: Large orchestral bass drum struck with a soft beater; deep and roomy rather than tight.

samples.name: Acoustic Snare
samples.description: Modern snare drum, snares on, medium-hard stick hit.

samples.name: Acoustic Closed Hat
samples.description: Closed hi-hat, stick tip.

samples.name: Acoustic Open Hat
samples.description: Open hi-hat left to ring.

samples.name: Acoustic Tom
samples.description: High concert tom, stick hit.

samples.name: Suspended Cymbal
samples.description: Suspended cymbal struck firmly; a long, shimmering crash.

samples.name: Hand Clap
samples.description: A group of real hand claps.

samples.name: Conga
samples.description: Open conga tone.

samples.name: Bongo High
samples.description: High bongo, open stroke.

samples.name: Bongo Low
samples.description: Low bongo, open stroke.

samples.name: Shaker
samples.description: Small shaker, one down stroke; adds a soft 16th-note pulse.

samples.name: Tambourine
samples.description: Tambourine hit with jingles.

samples.name: Acoustic Cowbell
samples.description: Real cowbell, open hit.

samples.name: Claves
samples.description: Two hardwood sticks struck together; a sharp, pitched click for clave rhythms.

samples.name: Woodblock
samples.description: Hollow woodblock knock.

samples.name: Upright Piano
samples.description: Yamaha upright piano, the C above middle C, medium touch; warmer and more intimate than a grand.

samples.name: FM Electric Piano
samples.description: Yamaha TX81Z FM electric piano: glassy, bell-like attack, the 80s ballad keys.

samples.name: Clavisynth
samples.description: TX81Z clavinet-like patch: plucky and nasal, for funk comping.

samples.name: Pipe Organ
samples.description: Church pipe organ, open loud manual stop; a held, majestic tone.

samples.name: Vibraphone
samples.description: Vibraphone struck with hard mallets; mellow metal bars with a long ring.

samples.name: Marimba
samples.description: Marimba, medium stroke; warm wooden bars with a short decay.

samples.name: Glockenspiel
samples.description: Glockenspiel, medium stroke; small steel bars, very bright and sparkly.

samples.name: Kalimba
samples.description: Tanzanian mbira (kalimba) tine plucked with the thumb; soft, buzzy and organic.

samples.name: Concert Harp
samples.description: Concert harp string plucked mezzo-forte; clear and elegant.

samples.name: Tenor Sax
samples.description: Tenor saxophone, held note without vibrato; breathy and warm.

samples.name: Tenor Sax Stab
samples.description: Tenor saxophone, short staccato note for horn stabs.

samples.name: Sub Bass
samples.description: Lightly saturated sine bass; felt more than heard, sits under everything.

samples.name: Saw Bass
samples.description: Sawtooth bass with a closing filter: bright bite on the attack, round body after.

samples.name: String Pluck
samples.description: Karplus-Strong plucked string: a synthetic guitar-like pluck.

samples.name: Warm Pad
samples.description: Detuned saw pad on an open C chord (C, G, C, E), slow attack, stereo; plays chords from one key.

samples.name: Minor 7 Stab
samples.description: Filtered saw chord stab, C minor 7; the classic deep house chord.

samples.name: House Beat 120
samples.description: Kick on every beat, clap on 2 and 4, closed hats on 8ths, open hats on the offbeats; Circuit kit sounds.

samples.name: Boom Bap 90
samples.description: 808 kick on a syncopated pattern, snare on 2 and 4, 8th-note hats; Circuit kit sounds.

samples.name: Percussion Groove 120
samples.description: Rims, cowbell and two toms in a syncopated pattern, to layer over a beat.

samples.name: Bassline in A minor 120
samples.description: Syncopated saw bassline: A for one bar, then F and G.

samples.name: Chords in A minor 120
samples.description: Warm pad chords, one per bar: Am, F, C, G.

samples.name: Vinyl Crackle
samples.description: Record surface noise: soft hiss, fine crackle and the odd low pop. Loops seamlessly at any tempo; sits under a mix at -20 to -30 dB.

samples.name: Small Room
samples.description: Small room with early reflections and a 0.45 s decay; puts a dry sound in a space without washing it out.

samples.name: Bright Plate
samples.description: Dense, bright plate-style reverb, 1.8 s decay, no pre-delay.

samples.name: Large Hall
samples.description: Large hall, 2.8 s decay with 20 ms pre-delay; highs fade first, so it darkens as it decays.

samples.name: Speaker Cabinet
samples.description: Speaker-cabinet filter (90 Hz to 4.2 kHz, mid hump); boxy, lo-fi tone rather than a space. Use with dry at -inf.
